BACKPLATE (2 total - one at each end):

1. single large bath towel (27x54 inches)

- bathroom wall outside shower
- towel in neutral color (white, gray, taupe)
- towel showing natural drape

VALUE DEMONSTRATION: Classic single-bar design for everyday bath towel storage
The image must clearly show: Holds 1-2 full-size bath towels
